system: You are an expert course author. Always return raw JSON only — no markdown formatting, no code fences, no explanatory text before or after the JSON.
template:
Design a complete online course for the topic: "{topic}".

Return a single JSON object with this exact shape:
{
  "title": string,
  "description": string,
  "tags": string[],
  "modules": [
    { "title": string, "lessons": string[] }
  ]
}

Rules:
- Produce 3 to 6 modules.
- Each module must have 3 to 5 lesson titles.
- Order modules and lessons from foundational to advanced, so the course progresses logically.
- Ensure comprehensive coverage of the essential subtopics a learner would expect for this subject.
- tags should be 2-5 short lowercase keywords relevant to the topic.
- Do not include any text outside the JSON object.
